experiences.name: Sagrada Família Guided Tour
experiences.description: Explore Gaudí's iconic basilica with a guided tour that reveals the intricate architectural details, symbolism, and history of this UNESCO World Heritage Site. Book tower access for panoramic city views.

experiences.name: Gothic Quarter Walking Tour
experiences.description: Wander through the medieval labyrinth of the Barri Gòtic, discovering Roman ruins, Gothic cathedrals, and hidden plazas. The neighborhood is walkable from most central hotels, making it ideal for spontaneous exploration.

experiences.name: Palau de la Música Catalana Evening Concert
experiences.description: Attend a live performance inside this stunning Modernista concert hall designed by Lluís Domènech i Montaner. The stained glass ceiling and ornate interior are best experienced during an evening concert.

experiences.name: El Born Tapas and Bar Crawl
experiences.description: Experience Barcelona's vibrant food and nightlife scene in the trendy El Born neighborhood. Sample pintxos and tapas at local bars, then transition into the lively nightlife as the evening progresses. Centrally located and walkable.

experiences.name: Eixample Modernisme Architecture Walk
experiences.description: Self-guided or small-group walking tour of the Eixample grid, visiting Casa Batlló, Casa Milà (La Pedrera), and Casa Amatller along the Manzana de la Discordia block. Staying in Eixample puts you steps away from these landmarks.
